strings.name: John Collison
strings.summary: John Collison cofounded Stripe with his older brother Patrick to make online payments easier for developers. As a teenager he helped found and sell Auctomatic, then left Harvard to build a business. Stripe expanded into subscription billing, company formation and stablecoin infrastructure for global internet commerce. Its platform's merchant transaction volume should not be confused with company revenue.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Cofounds Stripe and helps build a developer-focused payments platform and infrastructure for global internet commerce.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Studied physics at Harvard University; did not complete a degree
strings.highlights.h1.title: Simplifying online payment acceptance
strings.highlights.h1.text: With his brother and their team, he built payment tools developers could integrate, reducing technical barriers for internet businesses.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Broader commercial infrastructure
strings.highlights.h2.text: Stripe expanded from payments into Atlas company formation, subscription billing and Bridge stablecoin services for businesses of different sizes.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Reporting 2025 business progress
strings.timeline.t1.text: The brothers' joint annual letter reported $1.9 trillion in annual merchant transaction volume, up 34%; this is not Stripe's own revenue.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Bridge acquisition completed
strings.timeline.t2.text: Stripe completed its acquisition of stablecoin-infrastructure company Bridge, expanding digital-dollar and cross-border commerce services.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Large financing agreements announced
strings.timeline.t3.text: Stripe signed agreements to raise over $6.5 billion at a $50 billion valuation for employee equity liquidity and related taxes, markedly below its 2021 valuation.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Launching Stripe Atlas
strings.timeline.t4.text: The company introduced incorporation services helping entrepreneurs worldwide access US company, banking and payment infrastructure.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Stripe publicly launched
strings.timeline.t5.text: Following extensive testing, it opened to the public with payment integration at its core.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Cofounding Stripe
strings.timeline.t6.text: He started the company with Patrick as cofounder and president; their early coding exploration had begun the year before.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Entering Harvard
strings.timeline.t7.text: After Irish secondary-school examinations he went to Harvard, later leaving to pursue the business full time.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Auctomatic sold
strings.timeline.t8.text: The ecommerce-tools company he helped found with his brother was acquired by Live Current Media, an early entrepreneurial turning point.
